intro_mara_02.text: Mara: Expired. Very funny, Selin. Very... Selin?

echo_first_contact.text: ECHO: Dr. Voss. You are in Sublevel Nine, Biohazard Sector C.

log_11.text: Dr. Selin Aslan: Mara, if you're listening to this, I'm probably dead...

yusuf_intro.text: Yusuf: Don't move. Don't — wait. Mara? Mara Voss?

mahmoud_intro.text: Mahmoud: Mara. I'm relieved. I was beginning to think the inoculation had failed entirely.
